brief:
Israeli occupation forces breached the Gaza ceasefire agreement Saturday through sustained bombardment, demolition operations, and gunfire targeting scattered areas of the enclave, Shehab Wire reported. The strikes affected multiple locations throughout the territory as military operations persisted despite the truce arrangement.

The violations marked an ongoing pattern of Israeli military activity within Gaza. Ceasefire terms had established conditions for a halt to such operations across the densely populated strip. The Saturday breaches included bombing campaigns, controlled explosions, and direct fire directed at residential and other civilian areas distributed across different zones of the territory.
